projectTemplates.title: Project templates
projectTemplates.intro: A template gives a new project its stages, its tasks with leads, and its dates.
projectTemplates.empty: No project templates are saved yet.
projectTemplates.name: Template name
projectTemplates.rolesHint: A role leads its tasks. Each new project confirms the person.
projectTemplates.stagesHint: Days are working days, Sunday to Thursday. Day 0 is the project start.
projectTemplates.stageInstructions: Press Space to pick up a stage. Use the up and down arrow keys to move it. Press Space again to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
projectTemplates.stageDaysHint: The stage covers its own days and its tasks.
projectTemplates.noOtherTemplate: No other template is saved yet.
projectTemplates.timelineEmpty: Add a task with a start day and working days to see the timeline.
projectTemplates.timelineNeedsWide: The timeline needs a wider screen.
projectTemplates.timelineHint: Drag a bar to move it. Drag its end to change its length. Drag a dot from one bar to another, and the second bar waits for the first.
projectTemplates.loopLink: This link would make a loop.
projectTemplates.linkLimit: A part can have at most {{n}} waits.

errors.name: Give the template a name.
errors.roleTwice: Two roles have the same name.
errors.stageTwice: Two stages have the same name.
errors.stageNumbers: A stage needs both a start day and working days, or neither.
errors.numbers: Use whole numbers: a start day from 0 to 2000, and from 1 to 365 working days.

link.title: Link an older project
link.intro: Choose the project item that matches each template part.
link.dropHint: A template part with no match is dropped from this project.
link.linked: The project is linked to the template.

update.intro: Each linked project can take the changes of this template. Pick the projects to update.
update.askTitle: Update {{projects}} with the changes of this template?
update.askBody: Nothing changes yet. You pick each change. Then you confirm the update.

kind.removed: Items the template no longer has

update.peopleLine: People who lead or help the changed tasks: {{people}}.

choice.deleteUnstarted: Delete the ones not started yet

update.confirmBody: Each project takes its changes in one story. Undo all takes back every change of this update.
update.doneBody: Undo all takes back every change of this update.
update.stoppedBody: Undo all takes back the changes that were made before the stop.
update.limit: You can update 50 projects at one time. Update the rest in a second round.

templateUse.endHint: Empty keeps the length of the template.
templateUse.lengthEnds: Template length: {{template}} working days. The project ends on {{date}}.
templateUse.lengthNew: Template length: {{template}} working days. This project: {{project}} working days.
templateUse.tooShort: The locked tasks need at least {{needs}} working days. Choose a later end date, or let more tasks stretch.
templateUse.stretchHint: Ticked tasks stretch or shrink to the end date. Untick a task to keep its length.

errors.startRequired: A template needs a start date.

reasons.template_too_short: The locked tasks need at least {{names}} working days. Choose a later end date, or let more tasks stretch.
reasons.already_linked: This project is already linked to a template.
reasons.part_not_in_template: A part of the link is not in the template. Reload the page and try again.
reasons.item_not_in_project: An item is not in this project. Reload the page and try again.
reasons.duplicate_match: One project item matches two parts of the template. Choose each item once.
reasons.not_linked: This project is not linked to a template. Link it first.
reasons.other_template: This project is linked to another template.
